ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Fonts [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Fonts[/h1] [i]Real typefaces on ScriptedScreens consoles. Client-side only.[/i]
Use the game's own fonts and any .ttf or .otf file by name in a ScriptedScreens label, with the standard tag: [code]<font="Barlow Condensed">TANK 3 84%[/code]. There is nothing to call from Lua; the tag simply works, and so do [b]<b>[/b], [b]<i>[/b] and [b]<font-weight>[/b], drawing the family's real faces.
[h2]Highlights[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Every character a font file contains[/b], built the moment it is first drawn [*] [b]<b>, <i> and <font-weight> draw the family's real faces[/b], not a thickened or slanted fake [*] Text is kerned, from the font's own pair data [*] Ships the Barlow and Barlow Condensed families, every weight with italics [*] Add your own fonts in [b]Documents/My Games/Stationeers/fonts[/b], or download them by link, Google Fonts out of the box [/list]
[h2]Getting started[/h2] The mod folder holds four examples that run on paste, a quick start (QUICKSTART.md), a guide (README.md) and the release history (CHANGELOG.md), also [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]on GitHub[/url]. Every available font name is written to BepInEx/LogOutput.log. With StationeersLua's MCP server on, AI editors can read the same docs and the live font list.
[h2]What's new in 0.4.0[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Safer page fonts.[/b] A page's font links must be https and can no longer be redirected to a site you have not allowed, and a page over its 48-font limit is refused before anything downloads. [*] [b]More reliable loading.[/b] Fonts always load from their file, fixing a case where a downloaded font was saved under another font's name. Close the game before replacing or deleting a font file. [*] A font a page downloaded can no longer replace one the mod ships, and other mods can now tell when a font arrives late, so a page can redraw in it without a re-push. [/list] Full history: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url].
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] (required; it brings StationeersLua) [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] with [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [/list] Source: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts[/url] (MIT; bundled fonts SIL OFL 1.1).
